requirement: REQ-ARC-FCP-5595 (the pruner) / CLAUDE.md Failed-Experiment Rerun Discipline
inference_substrate_note: CARNOT_ARC_DISABLE_INDUCTION=1: the live E3AgentPolicy takes real actions against the offline arcade with NO LLM in the loop (no GGUF load, no CUDA). The pruner touches only the candidate-filter + frontier path, so the tier-3 generator is irrelevant to the lever and excluding it removes a large variance source. Same isolation exp5756 used.
verifier_is_oracle_note: No moat / verifier-value claim is made. The inert-click pruner is a candidate DROP-filter keyed on the agent's own observed frame-inertness, not an executable oracle, and this artifact reports a NEGATIVE on it.
solve_provenance_note: NO new solve is claimed. Every banked level appearing in these cells is a registry-known public-game level re-reached by the shipped agent as the A/B's control condition. The deliverable here is a lever measurement, not a solve. No public-game source was read; every number comes from the agent's own frames and its own counters.
random_seed_note: Three fixed seeds, MATCHED per cell between control and treatment (identical random.seed/np.random.seed and identical frontier_discipline_seed). Scoring is per-seed matched-pair; no any-seed union appears anywhere in this artifact.
reproducibility_checksum_note: sha256 over every measured cell row (both arms, all seeds).
duration_note: Sum of 150 real measured agent cells (budget 2000 each, both arms, 3 matched seeds) plus the 2-cell dead-channel probe. No LLM: pure offline-arcade agent stepping, 91868 graph states expanded in total.

control.name: E3_shipped_control
control.why_this_control: THE SHIPPED CONFIGURATION: frontier trio ON + HUD trio ON, i.e. arm G3's flag state, reached through the module defaults rather than through experiment_5836's arm kwargs. NOT arm A (that pins every lever off and is the PRE-flip agent) and NOT arm B2 (that pins edge_bar_hud_mask=False, so after the 2026-07-25 flip it is the HUD lever's treatment-absent condition, not the shipped config).

treatment.name: E3_shipped_plus_pruner
treatment.delta_vs_control: exactly and only what flipping SUBMITTED_INERT_CLICK_PRUNER_ENABLED does

arms.reproduction_sampling: ROUND-ROBIN BY ARM inside each (game, seed) cell -- never row order

acceptance_gate.gate: FLIP-CANDIDATE GATE (pre-registered before aggregating): the pruner is a flip candidate only if (axis1 capability PASS or UNINTERPRETABLE) AND axis2 efficiency PASS AND axis3 safety PASS. Efficiency is the load-bearing axis because the pruner's stated purpose is search cost, and it is the only axis with demonstrated support on this corpus.

axis1_capability.anchor_selection_rule: control prunable_pathology_fraction >= 0.10 on some seed AND control banks 0 levels
axis1_capability.why: No arm wins ANY anchor game at this budget, so 'new wins on anchors' is arithmetically forced to 0 whatever the pruner does. Reporting 0 here as a measured null would be the forced-value defect that voided the HUD arm of the convention-transfer battery. Capability is NOT MEASURABLE on this corpus; the efficiency axis carries the verdict.

axis2_efficiency.pass_condition: median matched delta < 0 (pruner reaches the first level-up in FEWER actions)
axis2_efficiency.witness_note: The metric is NOT frozen: it moves in BOTH directions on real cells (2 faster, 2 slower), so a negative-median pass region is reachable in practice and a FAIL here is a measurement, not an arithmetic artifact.

r11l_attribution_guard.note: r11l is the game the known-issues entry credits to this pruner. It must not headline.
r11l_attribution_guard.double_credit_warning: r11l is NOT the headline and CANNOT be credited to this pruner. On the shipped scored path the pruner OBSERVED ~1890 r11l click transitions per seed, tracked 81-94 signatures with 33-38 over its evidence floor, and pruned EXACTLY ZERO candidates on all three seeds -- the trajectory is identical to control down to actions and states_expanded. r11l renders a monotone step counter into the frame, so every action is raw-frame-CHANGED and the pruner's inertness predicate (computed on the RAW grid, arc_inert_click_pruner.py:217) can never accumulate specificity there. r11l's 0->1 level was delivered by the HUD/node-identity repair, and the known-issues claim that 'without it the pruner is what would have stopped 70% of the budget going to one wall-blocked click' is FALSIFIED by this measurement.

positive_control_the_lever_is_not_inert.why_this_matters: A null claim is not a finding unless the mechanism demonstrably had the opportunity to act (CLAUDE.md FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISK). It did.
positive_control_the_lever_is_not_inert.conclusion: The pruner fired hard (146k+ candidate rows dropped), changed the trajectory on a large minority of cells, and moved actions-to-win in BOTH directions. The null is therefore a measured null on an active mechanism, not a degenerate no-op.

measurement_path_defect_the_instructed_h.claim: Adding a pruner arm to experiment_5836_frontier_discipline_ab.py -- the instructed path -- cannot measure this lever, for TWO independent structural reasons.
measurement_path_defect_the_instructed_h.reason_1_no_kwarg: CarnotAgentPolicy (what every exp5836 arm builds, via _harness's CarnotAgentPolicy(game, {}, force_explore=True, **arm_kwargs)) has NO inert_click_pruner parameter and does not forward one to StepwiseExplorer. Verified: TypeError: CarnotAgentPolicy.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'inert_click_pruner', and 0 occurrences of inert_click_pruner in its StepwiseExplorer construction. An ARM therefore cannot express the lever at all; the only in-harness route is flipping the global flag, which this task forbids.
measurement_path_defect_the_instructed_h.reason_2_dead_observe_channel: Even force-attaching the pruner to that explorer leaves it blind. The observe() hook at arc_competition_agent.py:2525 is guarded on o.get('previous_frame') is not None, and a node's 'frame' is only retained when one of NINE optional components is enabled (goal_bias / dense_curiosity / action_effect_expansion_prior / qd_generator / controllable_novelty_policy / object_centric_proposal_policy / go_explore_archive / similarity_retrieval / click_pixel_sampling). An exp5836 arm enables none of them. This is the SAME dead-channel class already found and fixed for the HUD collapse guard at arc_competition_agent.py:2374-2379 (which reroutes to self._last_unmasked_hash / self._last_grid) and never applied to the pruner 150 lines below.
measurement_path_defect_the_instructed_h.consequence: An exp5836 pruner arm would report a zero-error, byte-identical, states_expanded-equal null across every cell -- indistinguishable from a real lever null and entirely a harness artifact. That is measurement failure mode #5 (an uninstrumented arm reading as a legitimate null). The scored path E3AgentPolicy is the only harness on which the flag can do anything, so the A/B was run there.
measurement_path_defect_the_instructed_h.existing_test_cannot_catch_it: tests/python/test_arc_inert_click_pruner_live_wiring.py's ingest->observe test hand-constructs explorer.awaiting with a 'previous_frame' key, i.e. it injects the one field a real bare run never populates, so it passes against a dead channel. A regression test that runs a DEFAULT-constructed StepwiseExplorer and asserts pruner.observed > 0 would have caught this.

prior_failures.what_it_measured: offline m0r0 prototype at explore_budget 6; 32 click transitions, 0 confidently inert
11 games x budget 200 x 3 arms vs the PRE-flip baseline; states 931 -> 953
prior_failures.its_retire_condition: 'do NOT flip SUBMITTED_INERT_CLICK_PRUNER_ENABLED... Per the retire condition, another plain budget/roster A/B is not warranted without a NEW mechanism that makes pruning reduce rather than reshape search cost.' ops/verifier_gaps.md records the gap RESOLVED-NEGATIVE (2026-07-20).

prior_failures.must_not_be_cited: Its add:inert_click_pruner arm reads macro_delta 0.0 with effect_basis 'exact_trace_replay_no_counterfactual_environment_delta' and causal_claimed=false. A trajectory-CHANGING drop-filter necessarily reads 0.0 under exact trace replay, and all seven audited components read exactly 0.0. It is a NON-measurement and must not be cited as evidence about this or any other component.

doomed_rerun_disclosure: This run is, by the Failed-Experiment Rerun Discipline, a scope-match to exp5756 with no operator_override on file (the exclusion manifest has NO entry for this lever -- all 57 entries checked). It was run anyway because the brief directed a measurement and because three things ARE different from exp5756: the control is the SHIPPED configuration rather than the pre-flip agent, the budget is 2000 rather than 200 on 25 rather than 11 games, and the harness is the SCORED E3AgentPolicy path rather than CarnotAgentPolicy. The verdict is nonetheless the SAME as exp5756's, plus a replicated safety regression exp5756 did not see. Per exp5756's own retire_if_same_verdict condition the correct disposition is RETIREMENT to ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml, not a fourth keying -- operator's call.
recommendation: DO NOT FLIP SUBMITTED_INERT_CLICK_PRUNER_ENABLED. On the SHIPPED configuration, over 75 matched pairs (25 games x 3 seeds, budget 2000, 0 errors), the pruner produced ZERO new wins on any seed, a median actions-to-first-win delta of +0 on the 31 cells both arms win, +12.0% states_expanded, and it LOST ft09's banked win on 2 of 3 seeds. Neither capability nor efficiency, plus one replicated regression. The capability axis is UNINTERPRETABLE, not FAILED: no arm wins ANY of the anchor games ['ar25', 'sb26', 'sc25', 'sk48'] at this budget, so 'new wins on anchors' was arithmetically forced to 0 before the pruner did anything. The verdict rests on the efficiency and safety axes, which do have real support (31 both-win cells; a metric that demonstrably moves in both directions). CORRECT THE RECORD in ops/known-issues.md (2026-07-25 DIAGNOSIS entry, recommended step 2). The clause 'without it the pruner is what would have stopped 70% of the budget going to one wall-blocked click' is false: the inert click mutates a HUD counter cell, so it is raw-frame CHANGED every time, and the pruner -- observing ~1890 r11l click transitions per seed with 33-38 signatures over its evidence floor -- prunes exactly 0 candidates and leaves the trajectory byte-identical. Only the HUD/node-identity repair could ever have fixed r11l. The exp5836 harness CANNOT be used to A/B this lever (no arm kwarg; dead observe channel). Fix that before any future attempt: forward inert_click_pruner through CarnotAgentPolicy, and source the observe hook's antecedent from self._last_grid the way the HUD collapse guard already does at arc_competition_agent.py:2374-2379, then add a regression test that runs a DEFAULT-constructed StepwiseExplorer and asserts pruner.observed > 0. If the operator wants to pursue the idea rather than the module: the one untested, separately-attributable mechanism change is a MASK-AWARE inertness predicate (compute `changed` on the HUD-masked grid at arc_inert_click_pruner.py:217 instead of the raw grid). It would satisfy exp5756's 'NEW mechanism' condition. Two constraints: its anchors must be games the ALREADY-SHIPPED auto_hud_mask unblocks (so the result is attributable to the predicate fix, not to the 2026-07-25 edge-bar repair), and r11l must not be among them. Also close the vacuous sacred rule first: pruner_tally_sacred was 0 in ALL 75 treatment cells, because leveled>0 can only be set after the run has already banked its level, so within an episode the safeguard can never fire. (Stated precisely: the pruner is the ONLY difference between the arms, so it CAUSED ft09's loss; this run does not isolate whether it dropped the winning click itself or reshaped the frontier away from it -- on both lost seeds the treatment expanded FEWER states, 236->210 and 629->222, consistent with either.) Otherwise RETIRE the lever to ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml per exp5756's retire_if_same_verdict condition (same verdict, fourth attempt), so a fifth plain roster/budget A/B cannot be queued.
what_this_does_NOT_establish: It does not establish that inert-click pruning is a bad idea in general. It establishes that THIS implementation, keyed on RAW-grid inertness with a leveled>0 sacred rule, buys nothing on this corpus at this budget.
It does not measure the 8 lost games' capability headroom, because no arm wins them: the capability axis is UNINTERPRETABLE by anchor-support, not FAILED.
It does not measure the pruner under a MASK-AWARE inertness predicate. That is a different mechanism and would need its own A/B (and would satisfy exp5756's 'NEW mechanism' condition).

It says nothing about the nav-side HazardMovePruner, which is not wired into the scored agent at all -- 17 of 25 games' single most-repeated action is a nav move, not a click, so the larger repeated-action mass is outside this pruner's jurisdiction entirely.

honest_verdict.principle: Terminal-prefixed so the conductor reconciler classifies it without re-running; the descriptive tail carries the negative so no reader mistakes a completed measurement for a win.

inference_substrate.principle: Declares that no LLM ran, so the duration floor applied is the arcade-agent floor rather than the 60s live-inference floor -- the ambiguity that false-flagged exp2837/exp5178.

per_seed_matched_win_sets.principle: Per-seed matched sets, never an any-seed union: a union inflates both arms and can show the control failing against itself (recorded measurement failure mode #3).

axis1_capability.principle: A gate whose anchor games are won by NO arm is arithmetically forced and is not a measurement; it is stamped UNINTERPRETABLE rather than reported as 0 (failure mode #2).

axis2_efficiency.principle: Carries a computed WITNESS that the pass region is non-empty -- the metric is shown moving in the pass direction on real cells -- so a FAIL is a measurement, not an unpassable gate (failure mode #1).

instrumentation_witness.principle: Every cell must emit states_expanded, an error count, and a nonzero mechanism-activity counter; an uninstrumented arm reads as a legitimate null (failure mode #5).

r11l_attribution_guard.principle: The HUD lever already delivered r11l's 0->1. Crediting it to the pruner would be failure mode #7 (wrong mechanism) on top of a forced value; the guard records the direct measurement that the pruner prunes ZERO candidates there.

positive_control_the_lever_is_not_inert.principle: A null is only a finding if the mechanism could have acted; without this block the verdict would be indistinguishable from FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISK.

measurement_path_defect_the_instructed_h.principle: A harness that cannot exercise the lever produces a clean-looking null; recording the defect prevents the next session from measuring the artifact instead of the mechanism.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: Content hash over every measured cell so a third party can detect corpus or shard drift between this artifact and any replication.

random_seed.principle: Determinism is the precondition for reproducibility; the matched-seed pairing is what makes the per-cell deltas attributable to the lever rather than to sampling.

duration_s.principle: Real compute takes wall-clock time; the summed per-cell durations are the load-bearing fabrication signal for this substrate.

repeated_action_jurisdiction_census.why: The pruner only covers CLICK labels (should_prune/rank_candidates leave nav+keyboard untouched by design). This census, measured on THIS run's own control cells, shows how much of the repeated-action mass is even inside its jurisdiction.
repeated_action_jurisdiction_census.note: 17 of 25 games' single most-repeated action is a nav/keyboard move and 6 games issue ZERO clicks in 2000 actions, including 5 of the 8 highest-pathology games. The nav-side HazardMovePruner, which implements the same trust+specificity discipline for moves and is consumed by OfflineSolver, is NOT wired into the scored E3AgentPolicy at all -- a strictly larger target than this click pruner's niche, and untested on the live path.
